name: dinner_money_low_balance
description: An alert that a pupil's school meal account is running low.
subject: School meals account running low - {pupil_name}
body: {pupil_name}'s school meals account balance is {balance}, which is below {threshold}.
Please top up the account at the school office or online so that it doesn't become overdrawn.
